content: In Leviticus, why does God tell Israel to be holy?
explanation: God's people should be like Him. “Be holy because I, the LORD your God, am holy.” (Leviticus 19:2, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, God commands, “Love your neighbor as…”
explanation: Jesus quoted this command. “but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.” (Leviticus 19:18, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, for whom should farmers leave grapes and the edges of the harvest?
explanation: God cares for the needy. “Leave them for the poor and the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.” (Leviticus 19:10, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, what should you do in the presence of the elderly?
explanation: Respect the aged and fear God. “You are to rise in the presence of the elderly, honor the aged, and fear your God.” (Leviticus 19:32, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, God says you must not steal and must not do what?
explanation: Do not deceive one another. “You must not steal. You must not lie or deceive one another.” (Leviticus 19:11, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, what was to be kept burning on the altar continually?
explanation: It must never go out. “The fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it must not be extinguished.” (Leviticus 6:13, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, what does God promise if Israel obeys?
explanation: You will be My people. “I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be My people.” (Leviticus 26:12, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, from where did the LORD call to Moses?
explanation: God gave laws for worship. “Then the LORD called to Moses and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting” (Leviticus 1:1, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, on whose head did Moses pour the anointing oil?
explanation: To set him apart as priest. “He also poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him to consecrate him.” (Leviticus 8:12, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, which of Aaron's sons offered unauthorized fire?
explanation: It was against God's command. “Now Aaron’s sons Nadab and Abihu took their censers” (Leviticus 10:1, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, on the Day of Atonement, onto what were Israel's sins confessed?
explanation: It was sent into the wilderness. “Then he is to lay both hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the iniquities” (Leviticus 16:21, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, where was the goat carrying Israel's sins sent?
explanation: It carried their sins far away. “The goat will carry on itself all their iniquities into a solitary place” (Leviticus 16:22, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, what is the seventh day called?
explanation: No work is done. “but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest” (Leviticus 23:3, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, what was the fiftieth year called?
explanation: Liberty was proclaimed in the land. “It shall be your Jubilee” (Leviticus 25:10, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, to whom does the tithe of the land belong?
explanation: It is holy to the LORD. “Thus any tithe from the land, whether from the seed of the land or the fruit of the trees, belongs to the LORD” (Leviticus 27:30, BSB)

content: In Leviticus' food laws, which animals could Israel eat?
explanation: God set His people apart. “You may eat any animal that has a split hoof completely divided and that chews the cud.” (Leviticus 11:3, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, what had to be added to every grain offering?
explanation: It is the salt of the covenant. “And you shall season each of your grain offerings with salt.” (Leviticus 2:13, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, what was the second goat of the Day of Atonement called?
explanation: Lots were cast for the two goats. “one for the LORD and the other for the scapegoat” (Leviticus 16:8, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, on which day of the seventh month was the Day of Atonement?
explanation: No work was done. “On the tenth day of the seventh month, you shall humble yourselves and not do any work” (Leviticus 16:29, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, on which day of the first month does Passover begin?
explanation: It begins at twilight. “The Passover to the LORD begins at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month.” (Leviticus 23:5, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, how many days does the Feast of Tabernacles last?
explanation: It begins on the fifteenth of the seventh month. “the Feast of Tabernacles to the LORD begins, and it continues for seven days.” (Leviticus 23:34, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, how many days were counted to the offering of new grain?
explanation: This became Pentecost. “You shall count off fifty days until the day after the seventh Sabbath” (Leviticus 23:16, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, where does God say the life of the flesh is?
explanation: The blood makes atonement. “For the life of the flesh is in the blood” (Leviticus 17:11, BSB)

content: In Leviticus, where did God appear above the ark?
options: In the cloud over the mercy seat
explanation: Aaron could not enter freely. “because I appear in the cloud above the mercy seat.” (Leviticus 16:2, BSB)
